title: Skill Marketplace Entry
description: One listing per skill under marketplace/. Tracks lifecycle (proposed/active/stale/archived), ROI/review evidence (instrumented load counts, incident usage, citations), and adoption. Metrics are appended by instrumentation only — self-report has zero weight; bananas earned through the skill is never a metric (circular).

skill_key.description: Skill DNS key — must appear in some skills/*.yaml manifest's skills[] array (CI cross-check).

owner.description: Node that published the skill (matches a skills/ manifest name).

version.description: Semver of the skill content this listing describes.

status.description: proposed → active; stale when adoption < threshold in window; archived = terminal. Entries are archived, NEVER deleted.

stale_at.description: Set when the watchdog moves the entry to stale (adoption < N in 60d).

archived_reason.description: Required when status = archived. Entry stays in the repo — archived, not deleted.

adoption.description: Recorded adoptions. Peer adoption is a SECONDARY signal — never the primary usefulness metric (instrumented usage + outcome evidence is primary).

roi.description: ROI/review evidence. Every entry must carry an evidence ref to a committed artifact (claim id, task id, PR, hash) — bare prose is not evidence.

load_count.description: Instrumented loads/usages of the skill, append-only.

incident_usage.description: Skill referenced during incident runs — how it performed under pressure.

citations.description: Skill cited in merged artifacts (knowledge docs, PRs, claims).

reviews.description: Quality reviews by a NON-earner reviewer (rotating).
